status.description: Where the tab is: no-tab (no open tab matches domains) | tab.

download.description: Start a signed-in download of one Drive file id as the given Google account slot (authuser), submitting the virus-scan interstitial for large files; the file lands in the browser's download dir. Returns {state:"started"} or {stop:"403"|"sign-in"}.

authuser.description: account slot from the folder URL /u/<n>/, default 0
